insight: Used by 100,000+ professionals across 1,700 teams in 134 countries.
name: JotMe
tagline: Agentic AI translation, transcription and meeting notes for calls.
description: JotMe is an agentic translation platform that delivers real-time translation, transcription and AI meeting notes in 200+ languages, preserving context and speaker intent. It works across Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet and Webex as well as in-person events, and gives each participant their notes and summaries in their own language.
edge: Live translation, transcription and meeting notes in 200+ languages in one agentic tool — each participant gets their notes in their own language.
pros: Per-participant notes in their own language
Works across Zoom/Teams/Meet/Webex and in person
cons: Free tier capped at 20 min of translation
